children.text: pratyekāntam udasram ekataraga-svāpāntar antar mithaḥ |
children.translated_text: in complete solitude, tearful, each absorbed in the other, in the interior of mutual sleep —

children.text: vaktraṃ paśyati mārṣṭi locana-puṭaṃ nāsāgram uddaṇḍayan
children.translated_text: [he] gazes at her face, wipes her eyelids, raises the tip of her nose,

children.text: niṃste gaṇḍa-yugaṃ hṛdā hṛdi milal lelīyate śarmaṇi1 ||9||
children.translated_text: kisses her pair of cheeks, and, heart merged in heart, delights in bliss. ||9||

children.text: gaura-śyāma-rucojjvalābhir2 amalair akṣṇor vilāsotsavair
children.translated_text: By the fair and dark radiances, brilliantly [shining], by the spotless festive play of the eyes,

children.text: nṛtyantībhir aśeṣa-mādanakalā vaidagdhya-digdhātmabhiḥ |
children.translated_text: dancing, imbued with the artful skill of all amorous arts,

children.text: anyonya-priyatā sudhā-parimala-stomonmadābhiḥ sadā
children.translated_text: by the swarm of the nectar-fragrance of mutual affection, ever intoxicating —

children.text: rādhā-mādhava-mādhurībhir amitaś3 cittaṃ samākrāmyatām ||10||
children.translated_text: may our mind be overwhelmed by the immeasurable sweetnesses of <s>Rādhā</s> and <s>Mādhava</s>! ||10||

children.text:
iti phala-niṣpattiḥ
 ||4||
children.translated_text: Thus the fruit-section concludes. ||4||

children.text: 1. (a) śarmāṇi; 2. oruco jvalābhir; 3. (b) abhitaś
children.translated_text: 1. (a) śarmāṇi; 2. oruco jvalābhir; 3. (b) abhitaś [variant readings]

children.text: pūrṇāḥ pulindya iti1 yā stutā vraja-ramādibhiḥ2 |
children.translated_text: 'Fulfilled are the <s>Pulinda</s> women' — those who were praised by the beloved women of <s>Vraja</s> and the rest;

children.text: na vayaṃ sādhvi sāmreti3 śreṇibhir dvārikā-śriyām ||1 ||
children.translated_text: 'We, O virtuous one, are not so' — thus [said] the groups of the glories of <s>Dvārakā</s>. ||1||

children.text: anayārārādhito nūnam4 itthaṃ pūrvābhir eva ca |
children.translated_text: 'Surely she has been worshipped by him' — thus, by the former ones [i.e., the <s>gopīs</s>] alone;

children.text: purāṇe kvāpi vaiśiṣṭya-sāmānyaṃ neyam ūhyate ||2||
children.translated_text: from some <s>Purāṇa</s> or other, the common and the special [status of <s>Rādhā</s>] is to be inferred. ||2||

children.text: rukmiṇī dvāravatyāṃ tu rādhā vṛndāvane vane |5 iti.
children.translated_text: '<s>Rukmiṇī</s> in <s>Dvāravatī</s>, but <s>Rādhā</s> in the forest of <s>Vṛndāvana</s>' — thus [it is said].

children.text: tasyāḥ kāntaḥ sadā kāntaḥ sa syād ekānta-bhāg vaśaḥ ||3||
children.translated_text: Her beloved is always [her] beloved; he should be exclusively devoted, under [her] sway. ||3||

children.text: yāv amū mama cittāntarbhūruha-sneham ūhatu6 |
children.translated_text: May these two bear the tree-like affection within my mind!

children.text: sad-bhakteṣv atulaṃ pitṛvya-7yugalaṃ kṛtvā madīyāṃ gatim ||4||
children.translated_text: Having made my uncle-pair (<s>Rūpa</s> and <s>Sanātana</s>) unequaled among true devotees, [as] my [spiritual] destination — ||4||

children.text: svaṃ dāsyaṃ diśad asti yat prabhu-yugaṃ tan me sadāstāṃ gatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: that lordly pair (<s>Rūpa</s> and <s>Sanātana</s>) who bestowed their own servitude — may they always be my refuge! ||5||

children.text: gaṅgāyāṃ kakucaṅgamuk śruti-madāj jāgrad-gataṃ māṃ prati
children.translated_text: At the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, at <s>Kakucaṅgamukha</s>, through the intoxication of scripture, [I was] awake, advancing toward me,

children.text: śrī-vṛndā-vipine trayīm api parāṃ svapnād avasthaṃ punaḥ |
children.translated_text: and in the blessed grove of <s>Vṛndā</s> (<s>Vṛndāvana</s>), even the supreme <s>Veda</s> is as if from dream. ||

children.text: yaḥ śrīmān madhumardanaḥ subhagatā sad-rūpatā viśrutaḥ
children.translated_text: He who is the glorious slayer of <s>Madhu</s> (<s>Kṛṣṇa</s>), blessed with good fortune and true beauty, renowned,

children.text: saṃjñāvān laghu-vaṃśa-śaṃsakatayā vande ca vande ca tam ||6||
children.translated_text: and known by the fame of the gentle flute — I bow, and again I bow to him! ||6||

children.text: śrī-kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa-caitanya sa-sanātana-rūpaka |
children.translated_text: O <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>! O <s>Kṛṣṇa Caitanya</s>! O one who is with <s>Sanātana</s> and <s>Rūpa</s>!

children.text: gopāla raghunāthāpta-vraja-vallabha pāhi mām ||7||
children.translated_text: O <s>Gopāla</s>! O <s>Raghunātha</s>! O intimate one! O beloved of <s>Vraja</s>! Protect me! ||7||

children.text: iti śrī-saṅkalpa-druma-nāma kāvyamāmaka-spṛhā
children.translated_text: Thus, the poem named <s>Śrī Saṅkalpa-druma</s> (the Wish-fulfilling Tree of Divine Resolve) — my aspiration,

children.text: dhāma śrī-rādhā-kṛṣṇa-rūpa-pūram api pūrayantam |
children.translated_text: the abode that fulfills even the full form of <s>Śrī Rādhā</s> and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>,

children.text: śrī-rādhā-kṛṣṇa-caraṇārpitam eva mama sarvam
children.translated_text: everything of mine offered at the feet of <s>Śrī Rādhā</s> and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> —

children.text: iti tad idam api tathā bhaved evam ||8||
children.translated_text: thus may this indeed be so! ||8||

children.text: iti śrīsaṅkalapakalpadrumanāmakāvyaṃ samāptam ||
children.translated_text: Thus the poem named <s>Śrī Saṅkalpakalpadruma</s> is completed.

children.text: śrī haraye namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Obeisance to <s>Śrī Hari</s>!
